open_question: No ZAG document names the lift. Macesnovc was reported closed for eight years before February 2016, which covers the 2012 inspection year. Position: placed on the only chairlift mapped at Rateče (OpenStreetMap way 292050650, named Macesnovec and tagged as not operating, read 12 November 2026). It is about 1,040 m long in plan, against 1,010 m for the lift "Lom 1" in the official list of 2006. The names differ and the ZAG reference list does not name the lift, so the link to this lift is an inference. The point is the northern end at the village.
